title: Assessing Representation Semantics Under Language Pretraining in Fine-Grained Classification
abstract: arXiv:2610.28051v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding how supervision signals shape semantic visual representations remains challenging, particularly in fine-grained, low-data settings. Standard evaluations of vision models rely on downstream accuracy, which often fails to capture structural differences in learned representations. We propose a compact explainability-driven framework for comparing encoders trained with classification-only and caption-generation supervision on CUB-200. Using a controlled two-stage protocol in which both encoders are ultimately optimized for the same classification task, we enable a direct comparison of the resulting representations. Saliency maps are generated using attention rollout and gradient-weighted rollout and evaluated with five metrics covering faithfulness (positive and negative perturbation) and localization (keypoint emphasis, background attribution, and Earth Mover's Distance). translated_title: 细粒度分类中语言预训练下的表征语义评估
translated_abstract: 理解监督信号如何塑造语义视觉表征仍然具有挑战性，尤其是在细粒度、低数据量的场景中。对视觉模型的标准评估依赖于下游任务准确率，这往往无法捕捉所学表征中的结构性差异。我们提出了一个紧凑的、由可解释性驱动的框架，用于比较在CUB-200数据集上分别以纯分类监督和图像描述生成监督训练的编码器。通过一个受控的两阶段协议（其中两个编码器最终均针对同一分类任务进行优化），我们实现了对所得表征的直接比较。显著性图采用注意力回溯和梯度加权回溯方法生成，并通过五个指标进行评估，这些指标涵盖忠实性（正向与负向扰动）和定位性（关键点强调、背景归因以及推土机距离）。在不同的随机种子和解释方法下，描述……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基于可解释性的评估框架，在细粒度低数据场景下通过显著性图的忠实性与定位性指标，比较纯分类监督与图像描述生成监督所训练编码器的表征语义差异，从而超越传统下游准确率来揭示监督信号对视觉表征结构的影响。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an explainability-driven framework that uses saliency-map faithfulness and localization metrics to compare semantic representations of encoders trained with classification-only versus caption-generation supervision in fine-grained, low-data settings, going beyond downstream accuracy to reveal how supervision signals shape learned visual representations.
